semiconductor_relevance: High — Nantong Crystal Co., Ltd provides critical materials such as synthetic quartz glass and epitaxial wafers, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Nantong Crystal Co., Ltd specializes in producing high-purity synthetic quartz glass and offers a range of semiconductor materials including epitaxial wafers and photo masks. Their products are characterized by high purity and excellent optical properties, making them suitable for semiconductor and precision optics applications.
